title: Palladian Symmetry Graphs: Dataset and Analysis Supporting "Reconstructing Palladian Symmetry"
description: Updated public reproducibility release for the article “Reconstructing Palladian Symmetry: Quotient Trees and House-and-Wing Morphospace.” Includes the corrected 16-villa SPD/SRI dataset, deterministic Table 1 and Figure 13 scripts, refreshed quotient-tree diagrams and supplementary workflows. Version v1.1 updates Zeno to Q=22, E_Q=22, 10 leaves, SPD=4.700 and SRI=0.045; all other metric rows and all morphospace assignments are unchanged. Diagrams retain distinct directed dashed connections with compact layouts and no redundant reverse arrows or self-loops.
